title: Compliant device is offered as an alternative to multi-factor rather than required

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy accepts', 'policies accept')} either compliance or multi-factor, not both

messages.businessImpact: A user with multi-factor can reach company data from any machine, managed or not, so device health stops being a condition of access.
remediation: Change the grant operator to require all the selected controls.
Test in report-only first, since this will affect people working from unmanaged machines.
